sources.title: Structural and practical identifiability analysis of partially observed dynamical models by exploiting the profile likelihood
sources.supports: Fix one parameter and reoptimize nuisance parameters; distinguish profile shape from local curvature; include initial conditions among model assumptions.
sources.limitations: Biological ODE application; transfer to TC-Lab is methodological. IID Gaussian/model-adequacy assumptions do not establish valid coverage for serial TC-Lab residuals. Equation extraction is not visual math verification.

sources.title: Identification of Continuous-time Models from Sampled Data
sources.review: Chapter bylines inspected. Two separate chapter attributions retained; book editors do not substitute for chapter authors.

chapters.title: Direct Identification of Continuous-time Models from Sampled Data: Issues, Basic Solutions and Relevance
chapters.supports: Input-output model and residual decomposition; residuals can contain measurement error, unmeasured disturbances and model inadequacy.
chapters.limitations: Introductory framework, not evidence that a chosen TC-Lab mean or covariance is correct.

chapters.title: Continuous-time Model Identification Using Spectrum Analysis with Passivity-preserving Model Reduction
chapters.review: Contextual reading lead, not presently cited. Publisher includes reference pages 407-408; author institutional record lists 393-406. Preserve discrepancy. Regression colored-noise warnings must not be generalized automatically to output-error fitting with exogenous fixed inputs.

sources.title: System Identification of Complex and Structured Systems
sources.author: Hakan Hjalmarsson
sources.review: Journal source acquired and method assumptions inspected. Source hash/profile in acquired_sources.json.
sources.disambiguation: Use journal version, European Journal of Control 15, 275-310; a same-title ECC conference version also exists.
sources.supports: Application-oriented confidence regions can target combinations; information-based prediction-error accuracy assumes true system in model set and differentiable predictor.
sources.limitations: Asymptotic theory does not certify finite-window coverage, physical-parameter uniqueness, or adequacy of the TC-Lab mean model.

sources.title: Generalizations of the Linear Chain Trick: incorporating more flexible dwell time distributions into mean field ODE models
sources.review: Journal source acquired; Theorem 1 chain/integral equivalence inspected.
sources.supports: Erlang dwell times admit a first-order ODE chain.
sources.limitations: Mean-field transition model. TC-Lab kernel moments and transfer equivalence are derived in this study, not experimental claims of this source.

sources.title: Adaptive experiment design for LTI systems
sources.review: Downloaded arXiv v2 dated April 16 2019, title Adaptive input design for LTI systems; published 2017 journal author order differs. Journal source still to acquire before citation.

sources.title: Input Design for System Identification via Convex Relaxation
sources.review: Cited explicitly as the inspected eight-page author preprint arXiv:1009.5614. Conference metadata identified separately; no unread six-page proceedings body or later journal outcome is represented as read.
sources.supports: Finite-time information design with amplitude constraints is nonconvex; the source develops a convex relaxation.
sources.limitations: Our multistart SLSQP does not implement this relaxation and inherits none of its approximation guarantees.

sources.title: A Simple, Positive Semi-Definite, Heteroskedasticity and Autocorrelation Consistent Covariance Matrix
sources.supports: Bartlett-weighted positive-semidefinite long-run covariance estimator; explicit conditions for consistency.
sources.limitations: Our fixed bandwidth sensitivity and nonlinear score approximation are not a demonstration of its asymptotic assumptions or coverage under model bias.
sources.review: Primary journal scan inspected visually and with OCR; equation symbols checked against rendered pages.

sources.title: The Stationary Bootstrap
sources.supports: Periodic extension and geometric resampling scheme; Remark 2 identifies the fixed-length circular relative and equal conditional sample-mean centering.
sources.limitations: Stationarity/consistency results for the geometric scheme are not a proof of interval coverage for this fixed-block nonlinear residual bootstrap with TC-Lab discrepancy.
